title: Wheedling at doors as I. Religion pays. Must see him for that par. Eat first. I want. Not yet. At four, she said. Time ever passing. Clockhands turning. On
html_source:
Bloom’s thoughts are fragmentary. ‘I want ’ is contrasted with the missing ‘I’ in the next sentence – ‘Where eat?’

What he wants is unspecified and is jumbled with hunger, eroticism and the anxiety about 4 O'clock.
